A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''smuggler''' was active in the [[Free Zone]] at the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Asylum]]<ref name="KOTFE 6" /> in [[3631 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}} As Rhax's [[Death/Legends|death]] is mentioned in a conversation occurring during Chapter VI, it must therefore have occurred by 3631 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a [[Unidentified thug (Free Zone)|thug]] in the Free Zone requested an item from her. Though the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] was able to obtain it, smuggling it out of [[District 1327|Breaktown]]<ref name="KOTFE 6" /> on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="The Old Ways of Zakuul">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Old Ways of Zakuul}}</ref> [[Zakuul]]<ref name="The Old World">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Old World}}</ref> resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a man named [[Rhax]], whom she counted among her best associates.<ref name="KOTFE 6" />

In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TOR Date" /> the smuggler was asked by the thug if she had acquired what he sought. She replied that she did, but on account of Rhax's death she would charge extra for it. The thug offered to give the smuggler enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for [[Whiskey/Legends|whiskey]], to which she replied that she desired enough to purchase whiskey of better quality than what could be found in the Free Zone.<ref name="KOTFE 6" />
